prompt: Find the area of the region enclosed by $y=4x-x^{2}$ and the $x$-axis.
markscheme:
Roots $x=0$ and $x=4$; the curve is above the axis between them **(A1)**

$\displaystyle\int_0^4(4x-x^{2})dx=\left[2x^{2}-\frac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_0^4$ **(M1)** $=32-\dfrac{64}{3}=\dfrac{32}{3}$ **(A1)**
